lines.text: I made Chunin, {player}! I've been carrying the vest around all day like an idiot.
They promoted me this morning. I keep touching the new flak vest to check it's real.
I've been put up a rank. More missions, more paperwork, more chances to get it right.
Thank you! You're the first one I wanted to tell, honestly.
Hearing you say it makes it feel real. Thank you, {player}.
Comfort? It's good news! ...Though I suppose I am a bit nervous. Thank you.
You'd help me get ready for the new missions? I'd like that a lot.
Oh. Right. I suppose it's not that big a deal to anyone else.
The new rank's harder than I thought. Good harder. I've stopped tripping over the vest.
A month in the new rank and I've led my first squad. Nobody got lost. Mostly.
I passed! The written part had a question about supply lines I'd literally dreamt about.
I passed the exam, {player}! I was sure I'd failed the last section.
The results went up on the board this morning. My name's on it. On the good side!
Thank you! I studied until my eyes crossed. Worth it.
Ha, no need to comfort me, I passed! But it's sweet of you.
Help me study for the next one? Deal. You bring the snacks.
...You could at least pretend to be impressed.
I've started on the next level of study already. The scrolls are thicker. So am I, around the eyes.
My teacher says the exam result opened a few doors. I'm trying not to let it go to my head.
I did something today I'm actually proud of. I fixed the neighbour's well pump all by myself.
Guess who won the dumpling-folding contest at the market? Me. Twenty-six in five minutes.
My work got hung in the tea house window. People stop and look. I've been walking past it on purpose.
Thank you! I wanted someone to say it, and I'm glad it was you.
I'm not upset, {player}! I'm proud! ...Come and be proud with me.
You want to help with the next one? Oh, I'd love that.
Right. Never mind. It's small, I know.
People still mention it, you know. I pretend I'm tired of it. I'm not.
That proud moment? It turned into a habit. I've been doing more of it ever since.
I've a cat now! Well, the cat has me. It turned up and won't leave.
I took in one of the kennel pups. It's chewed two sandals and my heart.
A sparrow with a bad wing landed on my sill. I'm nursing it. It has a name already.
Thank you! Come and meet the little terror. It loves visitors. Or their ankles.
Comfort me? It's a pet, not a curse! Though my sandals might disagree.
You'll help me walk it? Thank you. It pulls like a cart horse.
It's just an animal to you, I suppose. It's a lot more than that to me.
The pet's settled in. It sleeps on my chest now, which is lovely and very heavy.
My little companion learned a trick. It sits for fish. Only for fish.
There's a new baby in the family! Tiny, red-faced and very loud. We're all smitten.
My cousin had the baby last night. I'm an aunt! Or an uncle, or a something. A proud something!
We've a new little one at home. Nobody's slept, and nobody minds.
Thank you! I'll pass it on. They'll want to meet you, when the little one's bigger.
Ha! I suppose I could use comfort. Nobody's slept in four days.
You'd help? Bring rice, bring soup, bring anything. We're living on tea.
Oh. Well. Babies are everywhere, I suppose. This one's ours, though.
The baby smiled at me! Properly. Everyone says it's wind. It wasn't wind.
The little one's growing so fast. Already grabbing everyone's hair.
I've taken up the shamisen. The neighbours have taken up earplugs.
I'm learning to throw pots at the potter's on the hill. Mine come out like ducks.
I've started growing herbs on the roof. Six pots. Four of them alive.
Thank you! I'm terrible at it, which is half the fun.
I don't need comforting, {player}! Unless you've heard me play. Then maybe.
You want to try it with me? Oh, yes. Two beginners are better than one.
Not your thing? Fine. More fun for me.
I've improved! The neighbours only wince now. They used to flee.
The new hobby stuck. I've been at it every evening. I'm almost not bad.
I took a real step toward my dream today, {player}. Not a big one. A real one.
Someone who knows the trade said I've got a gift for it. Me! For my dream!
I saved enough to start, at last. The thing I've always wanted. It's beginning.
Thank you. You believing in me makes it feel possible.
It's not bad news, I promise. Though it's scary. Thank you for seeing that.
You'd help me toward it? I won't forget that, {player}.
I thought you'd care more. It's my dream. Never mind.
The step I took led to another one. I can see the road now. It's long, but it's there.
I've been working at the dream every day since. It's slow. But it's moving.
I'm moving house! Two streets over, closer to the river. My back already hurts thinking of it.
We're leaving the old place. Too many stairs, too few windows. I'll miss it anyway.
I've found a new home. Smaller, but the light in the mornings is wonderful.
Thank you! New start, new neighbours. Come round once I've found the teacups.
Thank you. It is a bit sad, leaving. You understood that without me saying.
You'll carry boxes? You wonderful person. There are a lot of boxes.
Right. Just another house to you. It's been home to me for years.
The new place feels like mine now. I put the old door charm up on the new door.
I've settled in. The neighbours are good. One of them bakes, which helps.
I lost to my rival. In front of everyone. I can still hear them laughing.
They beat me, {player}. Clean. I didn't even land a hit.
I trained for months for that match, and lost in a minute.
Congratulations? I LOST. Were you even listening?
Thank you. I needed someone to say it wasn't the end of the world.
Train with me? So next time I don't lose? Yes. Please.
I know losing's nothing to you. It's everything to me right now.
I fought them again. I didn't win, but I lasted five times longer. Thank you for not letting me quit.
I've stopped thinking about that loss every night. Only some nights now. Progress.
I'm off missions for a while. My ankle's bandaged up like a festival lantern.
I got hurt on a mission. Nothing permanent, the medics say. It doesn't feel that way.
Three cracked ribs. Laughing hurts. Please don't make me laugh.
Congratulations on... my injury? I think you misheard me.
Thank you. Lying still is the hardest part. It helps that you came.
You'll run errands for me? Bless you. The market's a long way on one leg.
Fine. I'll just lie here, then. On my own.
I'm back on my feet! A little stiff. The medics say I'm healing faster than they expected.
The bandages are off. I've a scar now. It's quite a good one, actually.
I've caught something awful. Everything aches and nothing tastes right.
Fever's come on. I'm not contagious, they say. I'd still keep your distance.
I've been in bed three days. I've counted every knot in the ceiling.
...Congratulations? On my fever? I'm too tired to be cross. Almost.
Thank you, {player}. Just hearing a friendly voice makes the fever feel smaller.
You'll fetch me ginger from the herbalist? Thank you. I'll pay you back in soup, later.
Right. I'll just be ill quietly, then.
I'm better! I ate a whole bowl of rice this morning and nearly cried with joy.
The fever broke. I'm still weak as a kitten, but I'm up.
The shop roof's leaking right over the stock. I've lost half a week's goods.
A supplier let me down. No delivery, and the festival orders are due.
Business has been slow for weeks. I keep counting the till and it keeps coming up short.
Congratulations? On losing stock? That's a strange thing to say, {player}.
Thank you. It's good to say it to someone who isn't a customer.
You'd lend a hand? Even carrying crates would help. Thank you.
It's my living, {player}. Not just a shop.
The shop's back on its feet. New roof, new supplier, and a queue at the door this morning.
Business picked up. I'm not out of the woods, but I can see the edge of them.
I've fallen out with an old friend. Over nothing, really. That's the worst part.
We had words. Me and a friend of twenty years. Neither of us will say sorry first.
My closest friend won't speak to me. I said something I shouldn't have.
Congratulations? I just told you I lost a friend.
Thank you. You're a good friend. I hope I can be one again, to them.
You'd talk to them for me? Or with me? I'd like that. I don't know where to start.
I suppose friends come and go for you. They don't for me.
We made up. I said sorry, they said sorry, and then we both laughed for no reason.
We're talking again. Carefully. It's better than silence.
It's not going to happen. Not this year. Maybe not ever. My dream, I mean.
I tried for it, {player}, and they said no. Just no.
Everything I'd saved for my dream went on something else. Something I couldn't say no to.
...Congratulations. Right. I'll just go, then.
Thank you. I needed someone to tell me it's not over. Even if I don't believe them yet.
You'd help me try again? I... yes. Let's try again.
It's just a dream to you. It was my whole life.
I picked it back up. The dream. I've a new way in. Thank you for not letting me drop it.
The setback was a detour. I'm on another road to the same place now.
We lost my grandfather last week. Quietly, in his sleep. The house is so still.
Someone in my family passed. I don't really know what to do with my hands.
We buried an old relative at the shrine this morning. I keep thinking I hear them in the next room.
...I said we lost someone, {player}.
Thank you. Just sit with me a while. You don't have to say anything.
You'd help with the shrine offerings? Thank you. There's so much to do and I can't think.
I see. I'll grieve on my own, then.
It's easier now. I still set out their cup sometimes. I think I'll keep doing that.
We had the memorial. Everyone told stories. We laughed more than I expected.
Someone I cared about decided they didn't care back. That's all. That's everything.
I let someone close, and they left. I'm all right. I'm not all right.
Something I hoped would last didn't. I'm trying not to make a fuss.
That's... not the response I hoped for.
Thank you. I needed someone kind today. I'm glad it was you.
Take me out of the house? Yes. Anywhere that isn't here.
Right. It's nothing to you. I knew that.
I'm better. I sleep through the night now. You helped more than you know.
I saw them in the market and it didn't hurt. Much. That's something.
I'M A CHUNIN! Okay, okay. I'm calm. I'M A CHUNIN!
I was promoted. As expected. ...I celebrated anyway. Quietly.
They... promoted me. I don't know why. I mean, thank you, but... me?
A little three-legged dog followed me home. I couldn't say no. It's sleeping in my lap right now.
I took a cat for the shop. Mouse control. ...It sleeps on the till and I buy it fish. Don't laugh.
Ill. Confined to bed. It's intolerable. I've done all my stretches twice.
I'm sick, and nobody's eating properly at home because I'm not cooking. It's a disaster.
I balanced the ledger to the last ryo for the first time this year. Not a single error.
Someone bought one of my paintings! A stranger! They said it made them think of the sea.
I've started taking apart old locks. Did you know some have seven pins? I didn't! Now I do!
They told me I can't! So I'm going to do it twice as hard! ...After I sulk a bit.
I lost. It will not happen again. I don't wish to discuss it further.
I passed the Academy test! I got every shuriken in the target. Well, nearly every one.
Now we're on the next scrolls and they've got even longer words. I'm still glad I passed.
Thanks! You can hold my test paper if you want. Don't crease it.
Why are you being all soft? I passed! Silly.
You'll study with me for the next one? Yes! You can test me on the hand signs.
You don't even care. I'm telling everybody else then.
I climbed the big tree by the Academy all the way to the top! Nobody else has done it!
I climbed the big tree again. Two branches higher. I'm the champion now, it's official.
I know, right? You can be the second-best climber. If you practise.
I'm not sad! I'm happy! You're weird.
You want to try it with me? Okay! I'll show you which branches are wobbly.
Fine. It was really high, though.
I got a pet beetle! It's called General. It lives in a box and it's very brave.
General had babies! Or maybe it found friends. There's four beetles in the box now.
Thanks! You can hold General, but gently. Generals don't like being squeezed.
Why would I be sad? I got a beetle!
You'll help me find leaves for it? The best leaves are by the river.
You don't like beetles? That's okay. General doesn't like you either. Probably.
I'm collecting the smooth pebbles from the river. I've got thirty! One looks like a frog.
I've got a hundred pebbles now. My mum says no more pebbles in the house.
Thanks! You can have the frog one. No, wait. You can look at it.
It's not a sad thing! It's pebbles!
You'll help me find more? You have to be good at looking. Are you good at looking?
It's not boring. You're boring.
I've got a cold and I have to stay in. It's the worst. My nose won't stop.
I'm better! I had to drink this horrible tea, but now I can play outside again.
Being sick isn't a good thing, you know.
Thanks. Can you tell me what happened at the Academy? I missed everything.
You'll bring me my homework? Okay. And a sweet. For being brave.
You're not even sorry. Hmph. Achoo.
My friend and I had a fight about whose turn it was on the swing. Now we're not talking.
We made up! We decided the swing can have two people if you squish.
Why are you happy? We had a fight!
Thanks. Maybe tomorrow I'll say sorry. Maybe.
You'll come with me to say sorry? Okay. You do the talking first.
You don't get it. It was MY turn.
I made Genin! I've got my own headband now. I'm sleeping in it.
Being a Genin is mostly chasing cats and weeding gardens. I still love it.
Thanks! You can touch the headband. Just once. Careful of the metal bit.
Why would I need cheering up? I'm a ninja now!
You'll help me practise for my first mission? Yes! Let's go right now!
You're not even impressed. Everybody else was impressed.
I've got a baby brother! Or sister. It's very small and it cries a lot. I like it anyway.
The baby grabbed my finger and wouldn't let go. It's really strong for a baby.
Thanks! When it's bigger I'm going to teach it everything I know.
Well, it IS really loud at night. So, thanks, I guess.
You'll help me make it laugh? It likes funny faces. Do your funniest one.
It's not boring. It's a whole new person!
My teacher said I've got real talent for the thing I want to be when I grow up! Real talent!
I've been practising every day since my teacher said that. I'm getting even better.
Thanks! When I'm famous I'll say you were the first one I told.
It's not a sad thing. It's the best thing!
You'll practise with me? Okay! You can be my helper. My first helper ever.
You don't think I can do it. I can, you know.
I lost the race at the Academy. To THEM. They did a little dance after.
I raced them again! I didn't win, but I was only one step behind. One step!
I said I LOST. Weren't you listening?
Thanks. I'm still a bit cross, though. A lot cross.
You'll train with me so I win next time? Deal! Let's start tomorrow. No, today!
You don't care. Fine. I'll beat them without you.
I sprained my wrist falling off the climbing wall. It's all wrapped up. Look.
My wrist's better! I can throw again. I'm not climbing that wall for a while, though.
It's not good, it HURTS.
Thanks. It only hurts when I move it. Or when I think about it.
You'll carry my bag? Thanks! It's really heavy with only one hand.
You didn't even ask if it hurt.
My grandpa died. Everyone's being really quiet at home. I don't know what to do.
We put flowers at the shrine for my grandpa. I picked the yellow ones. They were his favourite.
Why would you say that? That's mean.
Thanks. Can you just sit with me a bit? You don't have to talk.
You'll come to the shrine with me? Okay. I didn't want to go by myself.
You don't even care. Go away.
The teacher said I'm not ready for the thing I wanted to do. I have to wait a whole year.
I'm still practising. A year isn't that long. I'll be so good by then.
That's not a good thing! Did you even hear me?
Thanks. I still really want it. I'm not giving up.
You'll help me get ready for next year? Okay. That makes it feel better.
You think it's silly. It's not silly to me.
